# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers of Shepherds' Pride, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]ROOM TO LET[/bold], South Colony, behind the theatre. Dry walls, new insect screens, own boot rack. The theatre band rehearses Tuesdays and the rent allows for it. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]DECKHAND WANTED[/bold] at the fishery. Up before dawn, net mending, gutting. Must swim. Pay in credits and in fish. - [bold]JUNGLE GUIDE[/bold], licensed, knows the trails west of the river. Will not take you into the preserve without a CWPS permit, so do not ask. - [bold]NIGHT CLEANER[/bold] sought for the Riverboat Casino. Discreet. Do not apply if you talk in bars.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]THIGH WADERS[/bold], patched once, still keep the river out. Trade for a working dehumidifier. - [bold]FISHING JUMPSUIT[/bold], small size, worn one season. Smells of the fishery and always will.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: green canoe, drifted off the north landing in last week's rain. Reward from the owner, and no questions about who untied it. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: field binoculars on the south road, CWPS issue. The ranger who dropped them can collect them at the press office and tell us where they were looking.
## Notices - The Drunk Carp runs a carp fry on rest days. Every fish on the plate is one the river is better off without. - The chapel keeps a candle lit for anyone overdue from the jungle. Tell the rangers first, then tell the chapel.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
